findings.text: List-backed append/resolve/insert targets are composed as a two-part '<collection>.<id>' address, which _value_at_path cannot resolve (its listed-heads branch at line 1251 requires three parts), so those verbs' changed_targets never carry the current value the docstring promises; only state-set and decision verbs do.

The 'value read back off disk' assertion is skipped by 'if "current" in entry', so of the four op kinds exercised only state-set is actually checked; every dotted or list-backed target passes unverified.

This file imports _edit_plan from the changed module but was omitted from both gate arms, so the manifest's and done_when's claim that every importing test file was measured is broader than the gate run; its conflict check is version-only, so it is unlikely to hide an added failure.

_op_target_path is a second verb table beside _store._OP_DISPATCH (reckon/_store.py:3671); a verb added to the dispatch silently returns no target here, re-creating the per-path divergence this change removed.

justifications.durability: tests/test_every_edit_path_refuses_one_shape.py:207 reddens at the reverted base because a non-set verb then yields no targets at all, confirmed by the negative-control log; the current-value assertion at line 212 only runs for state-set.
justifications.evidence: The base and head arms plus the negative control are recorded with revision, command and EXIT lines, but tests/test_landing_write_races_every_writer.py:43 imports _edit_plan and was left out of both arms.
justifications.fit: reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:1273 follows the module's underscore-helper idiom and documents each verb's identifying keys; no plan, ticket or version identifiers appear in the new names or docstrings.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:1328 now resolves a target for every op verb via _op_target_path, so each op path's refusal carries changed_targets and the listed id passes at head.
justifications.reuse: No existing function composes an op's document address (searched reckon/_store.py and reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py for target-path resolution), but the new per-verb mapping parallels _store._OP_DISPATCH at reckon/_store.py:3671.
justifications.scope_discipline: All three changed files (reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py, tests/test_every_edit_path_refuses_one_shape.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/every-edit-path-refuses-in-one-shape.html) are inside the node's declared write paths.
